summary: Added a bounded mission-envelope companion contract for existing WorkBlocks plus a reusable normalization/boundary helper and deterministic harness. Historical WorkBlocks without the new field remain LEGACY_PASSTHROUGH/LEAF; explicit AGENTIC_MISSION supports inspect -> local plan -> patch -> test -> bounded local repair/retest -> verify without adding scheduling, claim, scope, promotion, secret or Human Acceptance authority. The harness is wired into the existing Guide recursive test aggregator, not a parallel workflow.
